# 44 Physiques — Full Reference

> Precision physique and contest prep coaching for bodybuilding, bikini, physique, and figure competitors plus driven non-competitors. Fully online nutrition, training, posing, and weekly check-in coaching, with in-person posing available in Florida, United States.

44 Physiques is an online physique coaching business that builds custom, data-driven coaching plans for competitors and serious non-competitors. Every plan — nutrition, training, cardio, posing, and peak week — is engineered around the individual client's body, goals, schedule, and weekly physique response rather than templated. Coaching is delivered fully online worldwide, with optional in-person posing for athletes located in Florida.

- Business name: 44 Physiques
- Tagline: Chase the Physique
- Website: https://team44physiques.com/
- Email: fentydavid@yahoo.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/44physiques and https://instagram.com/team44physiques
- Service area: Online / worldwide; in-person posing available in Florida, United States
- Typical inquiry response time: within 48 hours

## Service Descriptions (Expanded)

### Online Coaching & Nutrition
Fully personalized training and nutrition programming delivered remotely. Includes weekly check-ins and real-time plan adjustments. This is the delivery model underlying all 44 Physiques coaching — clients anywhere in the world receive custom programming and ongoing weekly adjustments without needing to be local.

### Contest Prep
For competitors preparing for a bodybuilding, bikini, physique, or figure show. Delivers precision nutrition, training, cardio, and posing coaching engineered around the exact show date, with weekly adjustments all the way through peak week. Includes 2 posing sessions per month and a supplementation guide in addition to the standard package inclusions.
Dedicated page: https://team44physiques.com/services/contest-prep/

### Rush Prep
A flat-rate emergency prep package for competitors who are 4–5 weeks out from a show and need immediate, focused coaching. Includes everything in the standard Contest Prep package (custom nutrition, custom training, 2 posing sessions per month, supplementation guide, weekly check-ins and adjustments), compressed into the final weeks before the stage. Paid in full upfront.
Dedicated page: https://team44physiques.com/services/rush-prep/

### Offseason Prep
Structured muscle-building programming designed to maximize size between shows while managing body fat, so the athlete enters the next prep cycle from the strongest possible starting point.
Dedicated page: https://team44physiques.com/services/offseason-prep/

### Lifestyle Coaching
For non-competitors who want a real transformation. Delivers custom training and nutrition for sustainable body composition change, health, and long-term habits, built around the client's actual schedule and lifestyle. 3-month minimum.
Dedicated page: https://team44physiques.com/services/lifestyle-coaching/

### Posing Coaching
Stage presentation coaching. Available via FaceTime for remote clients or in-person for athletes located in Florida. Builds the stage confidence and presentation skills needed to compete at the client's best. Included as 2 sessions per month within Contest Prep and Rush Prep.
Dedicated page: https://team44physiques.com/services/posing-coaching/

## What Is Included In Every Package

1. Custom Training Program — engineered around your training split, volume tolerance, weak points, and recovery capacity.
2. Personalized Nutrition Plan — macros and meal structure dialed to your body, goals, and the way you actually eat.
3. Weekly Check-In — photos, data, and feedback reviewed every week with real-time adjustments to the plan.
4. Peak Week Guidance — water, sodium, carbs, training, and posing walked through day by day into show day.

Contest Prep and Rush Prep additionally include 2 posing sessions per month and a supplementation guide.

## Client Onboarding Process

1. Submit the inquiry form in the Contact section of the website (https://team44physiques.com/#contact). Provide your name, email, coaching interest, target timeline or show date, training experience, current stats, training history, and goals.
2. Receive a response within 48 hours to discuss the best coaching package for your goals and timeline.
3. Confirm the package and start date. The first payment is due upon program start.
4. Receive your custom nutrition and training programs.
5. Begin weekly check-ins and ongoing real-time adjustments.

## Weekly Check-In Expectations

- Submit a weekly check-in via the Athlete Check-In form: https://zr5498tfmr-ux.github.io/44Physiques-check-in-form/
- Include front and back posing photos taken in good lighting, plus the requested progress data.
- The coach reviews photos and data and adjusts nutrition and training in real time based on progress and physique response.
- Diet adjustments are made weekly based on check-in data. Workouts are customized to body-part weaknesses and strengths.
- The client is responsible for utilizing the program and maintaining consistent communication.

## Peak Week Guidance Detail

For Contest Prep and Rush Prep clients, the final week before a show is managed day by day, covering water, sodium, carbohydrate manipulation, training adjustments, and posing, so the athlete peaks on stage day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does contest prep coaching cost?

Contest Prep is $275/month with a 3-month minimum ($825). A 6-month commitment is $1,650 and 12 months is $3,300.

### Do you offer online coaching if I don't live in Florida?

Yes. All coaching — nutrition, training, and weekly check-ins — is delivered fully online. Posing sessions are available via FaceTime for remote clients, or in-person for clients in Florida.

### What is included in every 44 Physiques coaching package?

Every package includes a custom training program, personalized nutrition plan, weekly check-ins with real-time adjustments, and peak week guidance. Contest Prep and Rush Prep also include 2 posing sessions per month and a supplementation guide.

### How do I start coaching with 44 Physiques?

Submit the inquiry form in the Contact section of the website. Describe your goals and timeline and you will receive a response within 48 hours to discuss the best coaching package.

### What is Rush Prep and who is it for?

Rush Prep is a $425 flat-rate emergency prep package for competitors who are 4-5 weeks out from a show and need immediate, focused coaching. It includes everything in the standard Contest Prep package.

### How are weekly check-ins done?

Each week clients submit front and back pose photos with good lighting. The coach reviews photos and data, then adjusts nutrition and training in real time based on progress and physique response.

### What is Lifestyle Coaching at 44 Physiques?

Lifestyle Coaching is a $250/month program with a 3-month minimum designed for non-competitors seeking sustainable body composition improvement, health, and long-term habits through custom training and nutrition guidance.

### What payment methods does 44 Physiques accept?

Zelle (preferred): 352-540-1695. PayPal: fentydavid@yahoo.com. Payments are due on the 1st or 15th of each month.
